title: Change-aware Evals dashboard + intelligent incident routing for regressions
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Teams need fast, actionable alerts when model or serving configuration changes cause quality regressions. Current evals surface regressions but lack stable mapping to the change that introduced them, and Console alerts are noisy when multiple evals or routes trigger the same underlying root cause.

Goal: Ship a Console Evals dashboard that ties each eval result to a change artifact (model version, config commit, rollout ID) and a smart alerting layer that groups/deduplicates regressions and routes incidents to the appropriate Slack channel or PagerDuty service. The feature should make it trivial to see which deploy/config change correlates with a drop in eval metrics and to reduce duplicate notifications.

Scope and assumptions:
- Backend will index eval runs with metadata: model_version, runtime_config_hash, rollout_id, commit_sha, and target_route.
- Dashboard UX shows timeline per model+route with change markers and highlightable failing test cases.
- Alerting supports grouping key options: model_version, route, or config_hash. Default grouping will be change-aware: model_version + config_hash.
- Dedupe policy: within an incident window (configurable, default 60 minutes) collapse duplicate alerts into a single incident with a summary and links to per-eval failures.
- Integrations: Slack (channel + thread), PagerDuty (service + escalation policy). Alerts must include: failure delta, baseline metric, top failing prompt examples, and a link to the eval diff.
- Rollout: staged feature flag in Console; beta for early customers and SRE teams.

Open questions:
1) What is the canonical change artifact? (commit_sha vs rollout_id). Proposal: capture both and prefer rollout_id for hosted rollouts, fallback to commit_sha for private deploys.
2) How to auto-resolve incidents? Proposal: auto-resolve when eval metric recovers above threshold for N consecutive runs (configurable).
3) How aggressive should dedupe be across related models (e.g., family variants)? Proposal: allow configurable grouping at workspace level.

Deliverables:
- Backend: indexing pipeline changes + grouping key algorithm + incident lifecycle API.
- Console UI: timeline view, change markers, per-eval diff panel, alerting settings panel.
- Integrations: Slack notifier with thread aggregation; PagerDuty incident creation with dedupe metadata.
- Docs: runbook for on-call, config examples, tenant opt-in guide.

Success metrics:
- 80% reduction in duplicate Slack/PagerDuty notifications for the same root cause in pilot teams.
- Median time-to-ack when an eval-triggered incident occurs <= 15 minutes for pilot customers.
- >90% of regression incidents link to a change artifact within a 1-hour window.
acceptance_criteria: Console dashboard shows per-model+route timeline with change markers and clickable eval diffs
Alerts group by model_version+config_hash by default and collapse duplicates within 60 minutes
Slack integration posts single thread with aggregated failures and links to individual eval runs
PagerDuty incidents created with grouping metadata and auto-resolve when metric recovers
Integration settings exposed in Console (grouping key, dedupe window, channels/services)
End-to-end test and a pilot with two customer teams completed
